what: The audit's pinned arithmetic, in one machine-readable place. Each figure is a number some test asserts against a local baseline nobody else has; recording them here makes them reviewable and diffable without the data, and tests/test_rf_benchmark.py checks that the record and the asserts still agree.
what_this_is_not: A measurement anyone can reproduce. These are facts about ONE edition of Tao's book and ONE imported corpus; the reproducible numbers live in tests/e2e/answer-key.json, which is about a synthetic fixture.
rule: None of these may move unless a finding says the number is wrong. Two of them are the traps the item grammar exists to prevent: chapter_1_items (411, not 410) and differential_task_universe (383, not 382).

environment.CF_MT: the checkout carrying the pinned PDF
environment.CF_BASELINE_CORPUS: the v1 run tree (findings, findings-gpt, findings-pdf, findings-hunt, findings-vac)

source_items_total.what: numbered items in the whole pinned edition

chapter_1_items.why_it_matters: the baseline's literal-single-space regex found 410 and the task generator dropped the missing one silently

chapter_1_items_single_space_regex.what: what the pre-fix regex found, kept as the documented defect

differential_task_universe.what: differential tasks over the pinned edition (225 paired + 158 single-source)

differential_pairs.what: items two or more companions formalise

gated_files_differential.what: converted v1 files that pass the differential-legacy gate

gated_files_attack.what: converted v1 files that pass the attack-legacy gate

corpus_findings.what: findings files in the five imported v1 runs (382 + 382 + 382 + 763 + 763)

ours_raw_items.what: distinct raw item labels behind those rows

ours_raw_substantive.what: of those items, the ones with a CONTENT/VACUITY/SUSPECTED_ERRATA/PROXY finding

ours_raw_high.what: of those items, the ones with a high-severity finding

ours_collapsed_items.what: the same rows counted by book item rather than by the worker's label

ours_class_content_vac.what: disposition class: items with a CONTENT or VACUITY finding

ours_class_page_anchor.what: disposition class: items whose only complaint was pagination -- 22 of the 40

teorth_raw_items.what: distinct raw item labels behind those rows

teorth_collapsed_substantive.what: substantive items BY BOOK ITEM. 41/19, not the 40/18 of the runs before 2026-09-18: one in-text label stopped collapsing onto the numbered item it merely cites (a de-conflation, not a new finding)

teorth_collapsed_high.what: high-severity items by book item (see teorth_collapsed_substantive)

adam_raw_items.what: distinct raw item labels behind those rows

def_coverage_stated.what: Chapter-1 Definitions the first companion states natively

def_coverage_bridge_only.what: Definitions it only ever consumes through bridges

def_coverage_missing.what: Definitions no declaration is tagged to

adapter_rows_first_companion.what: statement rows the docstring_tags adapter extracts (ours.jsonl had 1,157; the repo has grown since, so this is a floor)
